text: {"final": {"summary": "In inventory/stock.py, reserve_stock now validates the warehouse_id with is_valid_warehouse_id (imported from core/ids.py) before load_ledger() is called, raising ValueError(f\"invalid warehouse id {warehouse_id!r}\") for malformed codes like WH7. Because the check runs before any ledger read/write, nothing is recorded for rejected codes, and reservations with valid IDs (e.g. WH-NVL-03) work unchanged.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
